title: Right Form of Verbs Practice 2008
parts:
(go) to market yesterday?
(b) Would that I

(show) her in.
(d) Had I been there, it not

(read) in this college for the last two years.
(g) Unless you write the answers well, you
answers: Why he did he go to market yesterday?
Would that I could read Latin.
Show her in.
Had I been there, it not would have happened.
The boy not yet has not learned his lesson.
Chinmoy has been reading in this college for the last two years.
Unless you write the answers well, you will fail.
explanations: অতীতকালের প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যে (yesterday থাকলে) Wh-word এর পর 'did' বসে এবং Subject-এর পর Verb-এর Base form (go) হয়।
বাক্যের শুরুতে 'Would that' থাকলে অবাস্তব ইচ্ছা প্রকাশ পায়, তাই Subject-এর পর 'could + V1' (could read) বসে।
Imperative sentence (আদেশ/অনুরোধ) সবসময় Verb-এর Present form (Show) দিয়ে শুরু হয়।
3rd Conditional Structure (Had + Subject + V3) থাকলে পরের অংশ 'would have + V3' (would have happened) হয়।
বাক্যে 'yet' থাকলে Present Perfect Tense হয় (has/have + not + V3)।
নির্দিষ্ট সময় ধরে কোনো কাজ চলছে বোঝালে (for/since থাকলে) Present Perfect Continuous Tense (has been/have been + V-ing) হয়।
1st Conditional: 'Unless' যুক্ত clause-টি Present Indefinite Tense হলে অপর clause-টি Future Indefinite (will + V1) হয়।

title: Right Form of Verbs Practice 2009
parts: (be) the architect of his own fate. He can achieve what he (b)
(desire) to achieve. It is wrong to think that man's life on earth (c)
(decide) by fate. It is not fate but sincere efforts and indomitable courage that (d)
(shape) his fate. There may be ups and downs but he should not (e)
answers: True that a man is the architect of his own fate.
He can achieve what he desires to achieve.
It is wrong to think that man's life on earth is decided by fate.
It is not fate but sincere efforts and indomitable courage that shape his fate.
There may be ups and downs but he should not lose heart.
explanations: সাধারণ সত্য কথা প্রকাশ করতে Singular Subject 'a man'-এর সাথে 'is' বসে।
Subject 3rd person singular (he) হওয়ায় Present Indefinite-এ Verb-এর সাথে 's' যুক্ত হয়ে 'desires' হয়।
মানুষের জীবন ভাগ্য দ্বারা নির্ধারিত হয় (Passive Voice), তাই 'is decided' বসে।
Subject এখানে Plural (efforts and courage), তাই Verb-এর Base form 'shape' বসে।
Modal Auxiliary (should not)-এর পর সবসময় Verb-এর Base form (lose) বসে।

title: Right Form of Verbs Practice 2010
parts: (wait) for the coffee, the head waiter, with an ingratiating smile on his false face (c)
(bear) a large basket full of huge peaches. But surely peaches were not in season then. Lord knew what they (e)
(cost), I knew too a little later.
answers: Then a terrible thing happened.
While we were waiting for the coffee, the head waiter, with an ingratiating smile on his false face came up to us bearing a large basket full of huge peaches.
While we were waiting for the coffee, the head waiter, with an ingratiating smile on his false face came up to us bearing a large basket full of huge peaches.
While we were waiting for the coffee, the head waiter, with an ingratiating smile on his false face came up to us bearing a large basket full of huge peaches.
Lord knew what they cost, I knew too a little later.
explanations: অতীতের ঘটনা বর্ণনা করতে Past Indefinite Tense (happened) বসে।
'were' (Past Continuous)-এর পর Verb-এর সাথে 'ing' যুক্ত হয়ে 'waiting' হয়।
প্রধান বাক্যটি Past Tense-এ থাকায় 'come'-এর Past form 'came' বসে।
একই বাক্যে দ্বিতীয় Verb-এর কাজ সাথে সাথে সংঘটিত হলে Participle বা 'ing' (bearing) যুক্ত হয়।
অতীতকালের প্রেক্ষাপটে 'cost'-এর Past form 'cost'-ই থাকে।

title: Right Form of Verbs Practice 2011
parts:
(sing) a folk song.
(b) The play just

(speak) all over the world.
(e) I have

(visit) his mother every week.
(g) French is not easy to
answers: I wish I could sing a folk song.
The play just has just begun.
If you wanted, I would help you.
English is spoken all over the world.
I have had my revenge at last.
He visits his mother every week.
French is not easy to learn.
explanations: 'I wish' এর পর 'could + V1' বা Past form বসে।
বাক্যে 'just' থাকলে Present Perfect Tense (has + V3) হয়।
2nd Conditional (If + Past Indefinite) হলে অপর অংশে 'would + V1' (would help) বসে।
ইংরেজি সারা বিশ্বে বলা হয় (Passive Voice), তাই 'is spoken' বসে।
Present Perfect Tense-এ 'have'-এর পর মূল Verb-এর V3 (had) বসে।
নিয়মিত অভ্যাস ('every week') বোঝাতে Present Indefinite Tense (visits) হয়।
To (Infinitive)-এর পর Verb-এর Base form (learn) বসে।

title: Right Form of Verbs Practice 2011 Special
parts: (be) the architect of his own fate. He can achieve what he (b)
(desire) to achieve. It is wrong to think that man's life on earth (c)
(decide) by fate. It is not fate but sincere efforts and indomitable courage that (d)
(shape) his fate. There may be ups and downs but he should not (e)
answers: True that a man is the architect of his own fate.
He can achieve what he desires to achieve.
It is wrong to think that man's life on earth is decided by fate.
It is not fate but sincere efforts and indomitable courage that shape his fate.
There may be ups and downs but he should not lose heart.
explanations: সাধারণ সত্য কথা প্রকাশ করতে Singular Subject 'a man'-এর সাথে 'is' বসে।
Subject 3rd person singular (he) হওয়ায় Present Indefinite-এ Verb-এর সাথে 's' যুক্ত হয়ে 'desires' হয়।
মানুষের জীবন ভাগ্য দ্বারা নির্ধারিত হয় (Passive Voice), তাই 'is decided' বসে।
Subject এখানে Plural (efforts and courage), তাই Verb-এর Base form 'shape' বসে।
Modal Auxiliary (should not)-এর পর সবসময় Verb-এর Base form (lose) বসে।

title: Right Form of Verbs Practice 2012
parts:
(verb to be) mortal.
(c) He as well as his friends

(call) the queen of flowers.
(g) If you had studied regularly, you
answers: I wish I could sing a folk song.
Man is mortal.
He as well as his friends is selfish.
We are used to eating rice thrice a day.
He is swimming now.
The rose is called the queen of flowers.
If you had studied regularly, you would have passed the exam.
explanations: 'I wish' থাকলে অসম্ভব ইচ্ছা প্রকাশে 'could + V1' (বা sang/were) বসে।
চিরন্তন সত্য (Universal truth) বোঝাতে Present Indefinite Tense (is) হয়।
'as well as' দিয়ে যুক্ত হলে প্রথম Subject (He) অনুযায়ী Verb (is) বসে।
'be used to'-এর পর Verb-এর সাথে 'ing' যুক্ত হয়।
বাক্যে 'now' থাকলে Present Continuous Tense (is swimming) হয়।
Passive Voice অর্থে (গোলাপকে ডাকা হয়) 'is called' বসে।
3rd Conditional (If + Past Perfect) থাকলে পরের ক্লাজে 'would have + V3' (would have passed) বসে।

title: Right Form of Verbs Practice 2013
parts:
(to be) born to suffer.
(c) Many a student

(return) home, he had his meal.
(e) They

(play) in the field for two hours.
(f) Neither of the boys

(to have) done the home work.
(g) Each boy and each girl
answers: You told me that you would help me.
The poor are born to suffer.
Many a student was present.
On returning home, he had his meal.
They have been playing in the field for two hours.
Neither of the boys has done the home work.
Each boy and each girl has got a prize.
explanations: Principal clause-টি Past Tense (told) হলে Subordinate clause-এ 'will'-এর জায়গায় 'would' বসে।
'The poor' দ্বারা সমগ্র দরিদ্র সম্প্রদায়কে বোঝায় (Plural Noun), তাই Present Tense-এ 'are' বসে।
'Many a' এর পর Singular Noun ও Singular Verb (was/is) বসে।
Preposition (On)-এর পর Verb-এর সাথে 'ing' যুক্ত হয়।
নির্দিষ্ট সময় ধরে কাজ চলা বোঝালে (for two hours) Present Perfect Continuous Tense (have been playing) হয়।
'Neither of' এর পর Plural Noun থাকলেও Verb সবসময় Singular (has) হয়।
'Each... and each...' যুক্ত Subject সবসময় Singular Verb (has) গ্রহণ করে।
